name: 4-H Capitol Experience (Lansing)
what_you_do: Over three days, you join an issue group led by a teen. You meet elected leaders and policy experts. You hear from young people who made a change. You see state government at work.
who_can_apply: Youth from 9th grade through age 19. 4-H and non-4-H members are welcome. Non-members sign up in 4-H Online.
pay_detail: Cost not stated on the page read.
duration: 3 days. The listed session was March 16 to 18, 2025.
deadline_text: Only the March 16 to 18, 2025 session is listed. The next dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Sign up through 4-H Online. Contact Darren Bagley, bagleyda@msu.edu.
